name: gNMI Gateway
what_it_is: A distributed, highly available service for connecting to multiple gNMI targets and proxying streaming telemetry subscriptions. It decouples consumers from target connections via a local cache, supporting multiple exporters and target loaders.
components: Target Loaders (JSON file, Netbox, simple file-based)
measurement: Prometheus metrics exporter extracting values from OpenConfig paths
Real-time gNMI notification streaming to Kafka
Debug exporter logging raw notifications to stdout
configuration: Command-line flags for selecting target loaders and exporters
TLS certificate configuration (self-signed or custom CA)
Per-target metadata: NoTLSVerify (skip cert verification), NoLock (disable cluster locking)
Zookeeper address and tickTime for clustering
modes: Exporter-as-client (exporters deployed separately, querying a gateway cluster)
constraints: Pre-release/experimental status — API and behavior may change
Only gNMI Subscribe RPC is supported; Get and Set operations are not implemented
TLS is mandatory per gNMI spec; plaintext connections are not supported
Zookeeper tickTime limits make cross-region distributed deployments impractical
docker_services: zookeeper (ephemeral, development only, no persistent volumes — referenced in README, no docker-compose.yml found in repo root)
notable_absences: No gNMI Get or Set support
No built-in time-series database (requires external Prometheus or Kafka)
No built-in authentication beyond mutual TLS
No docker-compose.yml in repository root (404 on master branch)
